eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 6:54 PM on JUL 28, 2026 Effective until 7:54 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Owyhee County has issued an evacuation order: LEVEL THREE GO, for the areas of South Mountain, Pleasant Valley Road to Triangle, Treasure Valley Road to the Triangle Reservoir, Point Creek Road, Juniper Mountain Road, and the west portion of Mud Flat Road. Call Owyhee Sheriff's Office for further information at 2 0 8 4 9 5 1 1 5 4. This message was sent by the Idaho State Communications Center and is now concluded.
